correctness.rationale: Automorphism obstruction: affine homotheties preserve each named direction and every definable Boolean-modal set; empty marking has translations, singleton (q>2) has nonidentity scaling, any two-point marking has reflection about midpoint (including characteristic two). For q=2 any singleton a plus its named direction closures isolates each x directly. For q>2 and noncollinear a,b,c, intersect u- and v-direction closures of P to isolate a+(b−a)+(c−a), then use intersections with P to isolate b,c,a. For x outside anchors choose two among a,b,c noncollinear with x; intersection of their singleton-based affine lines is {x}. Gives depth≤3. Since W finite, singleton definitions generate every subset. Independent exhaustive modal refinement for q=2,d2, q=3,d2, q=5,d2 confirms minimum support1/3 and noncollinear triple counts4,72,2000 respectively; these are regression only. Number of noncollinear supports N(N−1)(N−q)/6 is exact combinatorial count.
